Package gov.Lab3

Interface Profile

All Superinterfaces:
Comparable<Profile>
All Known Implementing Classes:
Company, Designer, Person, Programmer
public interface Profile extends Comparable<Profile>
Represents a node in the social network graph.

A Profile can be a Person, a Company, or any other entity that participates in the network. Profiles are connected to each other via Relationship instances, which are stored in each profile's own adjacency map.

Implementations must provide a stable ID and a human-readable name. The getImportance() value is used to sort profiles when printing the network.

    • addRelation

      Profile addRelation(Profile profile, Relationship relationship)
      Adds (or replaces) a direct relationship to another profile.

      Note: the symmetric edge on profile's side is not added automatically; use Network.addRelation(gov.Lab3.Profile, gov.Lab3.Profile, gov.Lab3.Relationship) to create both directions.

      Parameters:
      profile - the neighbour to connect to
      relationship - the relationship descriptor
      Returns:
      this profile instance for method chaining

    • removeRelation

      Profile removeRelation(Profile profile)
      Removes the direct relationship to the given profile, if present.

      The symmetric edge is not removed automatically.

      Parameters:
      profile - the neighbour whose edge should be removed
      Returns:
      this profile instance for method chaining

    • getImportance

      double getImportance()
      Returns a numeric measure of this profile's importance within the network.

      The default implementations use the number of direct connections (degree) as the importance score.

      Returns:
      a non-negative importance value
